title: Phase 77 adds public-deliberation and adaptive-mandate controls
summary: Eight inactive standing and notice registers, eight inactive deliberation and reasoned-response dockets, eight inactive mandate-legitimacy and appeal registers, and eight inactive adaptive-review ledgers now expose how affected publics, rights, access, comments, hearings, dissent, appeal, mandate, and reopening would be governed. Ten new guides and four maps deepen the content layer without creating participation or mandate outcomes.
evidence_note: This release contains empty standing, notice, accessibility, participation, issue-response, legitimacy, appeal, mandate, and adaptive-review contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It does not contain an admitted Phase 76 cross-case finding, standing decision, notice receipt, public comment, hearing, consultation, consent finding, reasoned response, quality finding, legitimacy audit, appeal, mandate, adaptive review, mandate change, receipt, score, or ranking.
publication_effect: Adds ten Published briefings, four Published dependency maps, one searchable registry with thirty-two detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence, learning, portfolio, policy, stage, result, decision, implementation, impact, and operating states unchanged.
